The quasar's last upgrade starts here. §9Saturation§r: a Quasar Engine at§9 4,096 SM on Magmatter (T4) Disc Field Coils§r, its disc Stable or better (§9|E| at most 40§r) for§9 1 hour unbroken§r. It is saved with the hole.

§5§lHOW§r Run the disc at f 1.0 with the standard rig's trims and purges. An unattended disc at f 0.85 sits near E -16 and each eruption kicks it about 30 further, so the streak breaks at every eruption: Saturation needs a managed disc.

§5§lTHEN§r The §9Supermassive Lattice§r round the same quasar counts (the next quest). Until Saturation the GUI says "Reach Saturation first". A fully grown 4,096 SM quasar on its coils makes about§9 9,796 Bu/t§r (9.8e16 EU/t, 98 quadrillion): that is ×1 for the lattice's multipliers.

[note]Magmatter comes from the Godforge's magmatter mode, behind its EE upgrade. With Beyond the Stars' Eye, EE costs 8 Black Dwarf Matter frame boxes instead of 2 Universium ones, so Magmatter arrives with Eternity at Eye T7.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r the quasar's GUI shows Saturation met (tick the box).
